verdict.rationale: Shopify's own Tap to Pay docs say it accepts contactless credit and debit cards, smartwatches, Apple Pay, Google Pay and digital wallets in person, which covers the contactless and mobile-wallet parts of the story. Nothing in the pack documents chip (EMV) card acceptance, and an old community comment says the POS still needed chip support. That is an absence of evidence rather than a contradicted claim, so the verdict is partial, not disputed. missing for 10: documented chip (EMV) card acceptance, details of supported card-reader hardware, independent hands-on corroboration of contactless and wallet payments

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can accept chip, contactless, and mobile-wallet (Apple Pay / Google Pay) payments in person

citations.quote: Tap to Pay works with contactless credit and debit cards, smartwatches, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and digital wallets for fast and smooth checkouts.
